card.name: Dashes before dates or day numbers
card.fires_on: The dash or broken minus-sign character right after "Day" in a countdown of negative day numbers. It also fires on a hyphen or word just before a month name in a dated list.

modes.label: Negative day numbers
modes.description: The minus-sign character between "Day" and a number in a pre-transplant schedule table.

modes.label: Before a month date
modes.description: A dash or word that comes just before a month abbreviation and date in news lists.

card.writes: It pushes up month-like and "jun" tokens such as Jun, Jul and junction, so it seems to anticipate a month name.
card.plain: It fires on the dash just before a day number or a month name in schedules and dated lists.
